title: The Summit of Patagonia's dry side
author: Wendell Zhou
blurb: Yara Almeida, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the concession permits expire.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
